Strategy: Combine the winning wide band with a sliver penalty: reward leftovers between twenty-five and fifty, penalize leftovers below ten. It may help by both attracting good leftovers and repelling dead ones, but may fail if the two effects pull in opposite directions.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 50 else 0) - (25 if r - item < 10 else 0) for r in bins]
```
